itemList.description: Demolishing brick work manually/ by mechanical means including stacking of serviceable material and disposal of unserviceable material to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge./ In cement mortar  ( I.No.19.7.3, P.No.187, Buildings Common Schedule of Rates: 2023-24 Volume 2) ---- All Other Terms and Conditions as per Bid Document

Providing and laying in Cement Concrete for all Basement & surface level works, return walls, retaining walls, sunken floors etc. The granite/trap/ basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications.M25 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates ( I.No.2.3.2, P.No.16,  Buildings Common Schedule of Rates: 2023-24 Volume 2) ---- All Other Terms and Conditions as per Bid Document
Adding Shuttering Cost 70% ---- All Other Terms and Conditions as per Bid Document

Fabricating, providing and erecting in position of M.S. Hot dip galvanised Sq. hallow pipes of 132 x132 heavy gauge of length 3000mm with MS.Hot dip galvanised grill work as per approved design & drawing of chief architect using 75 x12 mm galvanised flat for alround frame and 20 x 20 mm galvanised forged design with sq rod vertical at 150 mm c/cas shown in the drawing including providing forged ornamental arrow head of top and bottom. The work is inclusive of throughing flat square rod, placing welding all joints, including grinding, finishing, metal paint and painting 2 coat of anticorrosive paint over one coat o metal primer. The rate inclusive of all materials like M.S.hallow galvanised pipes, flats, forged square rods, cost of labour, for all items of work, cost of painting, wedding, cutting, grinding, with all leads and lift and as per specification, including loading and unloading with cost and conveyance of all material, labour, machinery and incidental charges ---- All Other Terms and Conditions as per Bid Document

Painting with synthetic enamel paint of approved brand and manufacture to give an even
shade: Two coats on new work after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge (Page No.48 item No.8.40, Vol.2 PWD SR 2023-24) ---- All Other Terms and Conditions as per Bid Document

Disposal of building rubbish / malba / similar unserviceable, dismantled or waste materials by mechanical means, including loading, transporting, unloading to approved municipal dumping ground or as approved by Engineer-in-charge to the appropriate disposal area (Page No.193, item No.19.59 Vol.2 PWDSR 2023-24) ---- All Other Terms and Conditions as per Bid Document
